title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - NetRelation
description: Net Relation (era:NetRelation's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Defines a relation between two elements. Inherits attributes from era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NetRelation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

elementA.description:
Relationship. References the first topological element in an oriented relation.
For example, it may indicate the object that corresponds to a section of line, an operational point or a track inside an operational point connected at start. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.0.1.2, 1.2.4.1)

elementB.description:
Relationship. References the second topological linear element in an oriented relation.
For example, it may indicate the object that corresponds to a section of line, an operational point or a track inside an operational point connected at end. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.0.1.2, 1.2.4.1)

isOnOriginOfElementA.description: Property. Determines if the position of the topological element A in a relation is the origin of element A. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.0.1.2, 1.2.4.1)

isOnOriginOfElementB.description: Property. Determines if the position of the topological element B in a relation is the origin of element B. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.0.1.2, 1.2.4.1)

navigability.description: Property. Indicates the navigation possibilities between two related topological linear elements. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.0.1.2, 1.2.4.1) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Navigabilities' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/navigabilities/Navigabilities), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
